description: What changed in FrontMCP after `from` up to `to` (the endpoint's version by default): each release's notes, every note the docs make about a change ("Changed in 1.9.5: before, …"), with its page and section, and, when both versions are documented, which pages changed. `from` can be any release, documented or not. Use it to upgrade a project, or to check whether docs for one version hold for another.

limit.description: How many notes to return, newest first.

section.description: Only notes from this part of the docs.

to.description: A documented FrontMCP version, like "1.9.4", or a minor, like "1.9", for its newest patch. Pass the version resolve_version found for the project. Defaults to the version this endpoint serves.

name: whats_changed
title: What changed between two releases
